change_interpretations.engineering_summary: The requirement was reworded from 'unavailable' to 'lost' and 'log' to 'record' without changing the underlying degraded mode logic or diagnostic event recording behavior.

assessments.reason: This test verifies driver torque response time under unchanged requirement VCU-DR-01 and is completely unrelated to wheel-speed sensor degradation.
This test exercises brake and pedal torque arbitration under unchanged requirements VCU-DR-01 and VCU-BRK-03.
This test evaluates high-load pedal demand transient timing, which is unrelated to the sensor degradation requirement VCU-DGN-04.
evidence: procedure: Sweep demand 75–95% at nominal and high-load cases
VCU-DGN-04 change is limited to wheel-speed sensor degradation text
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for this change.

assessments.reason: This test verifies brake actuator response latency against unchanged requirement VCU-BRK-03.

The test verifies wheel-speed sensor signal loss and fault logging under VCU-DGN-04. Because the change to VCU-DGN-04 is an editorial rewording with identical meaning, no functional behavior or verification criteria altered.
evidence: old_text: enter a degraded operating mode and log a diagnostic event
new_text: switch to a degraded operating mode and record a diagnostic event
assessments.recommended_action: Retain existing test procedure and PASS result as valid evidence.

assessments.reason: This test verifies mode event logging under unchanged requirement VCU-LOG-05.
The test procedure evaluates thermal acceleration torque delivery, which is content-wise unrelated to the wheel-speed sensor degradation requirement VCU-DGN-04.
evidence: procedure: At 80% pedal and elevated load, check that torque delivery is consistent...
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for this specification change.

assessments.reason: This test executes a legacy diagnostic replay trace, which has no relationship to wheel-speed sensor degradation under VCU-DGN-04.
evidence: VCU-DGN-04 change concerns wheel-speed signal loss
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for this specification change.

assessments.reason: This test checks drive mode torque ramping profiles under unchanged requirement VCU-MOD-06.
This test checks pedal signal noise filtering under unchanged requirement VCU-DR-02.
This test verifies torque cancellation priority during braking under unchanged requirement VCU-BRK-03.
This test checks ECU wake-up and startup timing, which is completely independent of wheel-speed sensor degradation.
evidence: procedure: Power cycle the ECU; verify readiness within 500 ms
VCU-DGN-04 change concerns wheel-speed signal loss
